reviews.author: Max Friend
reviews.text: Little Guy towing was the only tow truck I could get to come pick me up after my truck broke down in North Myrtle Beach, I called 3 other tow truck companies and none of them wanted to come get me but Little guy said “Absolutely I’ll be there in 25 minutes”. He loaded my truck on his flatbed and took me to the only mechanic he trusted about 20-30 minutes away. His rates are very fair and reasonable and I will only use little guy towing if/whenever I breakdown in Horry county again!

reviews.author: Meghann Clayton
reviews.text: Coming from an owner of a towing company, he was top notch. I was on vacation from TN with my boyfriend and 2 children, 7 weeks and 5 years. Our brakes went out in the car and it would be a few days before we could get the part to fix them. We called Terry and within 30 minutes he was to us. We called 4 other companies, they either didnt do long hauling or didnt have a truck large enough. He charged us an amazing price for going 385 miles.. Highly recommended!! Thanks!!

reviews.author: Christa Maxwell
reviews.text: My husband and I were in the process of moving to the Horry County area and I began to see sparks flying from underneath the truck/trailer. We pulled over outside of Conway to find that a tire had blown. We called AAA and they said that they didn’t provide service to trailers (Cancel Subscription). It was close 11:00 and everything around us was closed; including the big Walmart! So, my husband googled local towing shops in the area. After several calls back and forth with the owner of Old Phucker Towing, he arranged for one of his friends to bring us a tire that fit the trailer. Midnight y’all! It was such a blessing to have good hearted folks come help us out during a time of need. We are super grateful for this company that, like their slogan says, got us home!

reviews.author: Shane Neisius
reviews.text: My family and I were visiting from out of state when our car broke down, we decided to call old phuckers because the name is hilarious! We got amazing service and the price was right! Didn't try to take advantage of us even though we were not local! We would definitely recommend them to anybody needing their services!

reviews.author: James Moye
reviews.text: Very helpful, professional, Fast, no issues & excellent communication before and after car picked up & delivered..
